## Description

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature
- [ ] Documentation (README, templates, etc.)

## How did you test it?

- Distribution and version:

## Checklist

- [ ] `LINT_STRICT=1 bash tests/lint.sh` passes
- [ ] `bash tests/run.sh` passes

- [ ] No generated files, temporary files or credentials are included
